subject: Next steps & success gates — proposed 6-week trial plan for Helix IO
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@helix.io>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@helix.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & success gates — proposed 6-week trial plan for Helix IO

Hi Emily / Marcus —

Thanks again for your time earlier today. Quick recap from our call plus a lean, actionable trial plan you can share with the team. I attached a light spreadsheet with timelines and owner assignments (redwood_6week_trial_plan.xlsx) and a short doc with the acceptance criteria I captured (helix_success_criteria_draft.docx).

High-level proposal (6 weeks) — scoped to the three primary use cases you flagged: ingest enrichment, retrieval-augmented answers for agent desk, and nightly batch summarization.

1) Success gates (what we’ll measure):
   - Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 400ms for typical conversational calls (1k token context)
   - Cost: per-call inference token cost within 25% of our shared estimate in slide 7
   - Quality: human eval pass-rate >= 88% on 150 prompt checks across the three use cases
   - Integration: end-to-end pipeline with your staging S3 and API proxy by week 3

2) Timeline & milestones:
   - Week 0 (this week): contract signature (trial terms) + security kickoff (SOC2 questionnaire, network access)
   - Weeks 1–2: model selection + infra config; initial integration and sample traffic
   - Week 3: internal smoke tests + first QA pass; initial latency & cost baseline
   - Weeks 4–5: iterative tuning (batching/quantization suggestions), quality evals on 150 prompts
   - Week 6: final evaluation, a short exec review, and recommended next steps (scale, dedicated capacity)

3) Owners (suggested):
   - Redwood technical lead: Ben Carter — runtime tuning, model config, benchmark runs
   - Redwood engagement lead: Rachel Kim — project cadence, success criteria, stakeholder updates
   - Helix engineering lead: Marcus Lee — staging infra + data access
   - Helix product: Emily Torres — acceptance signoff, quality feedback

4) Security & procurement items:
   - We’ll need a completed vendor security questionnaire (I can share our draft answers first) and temporary staging credentials for S3 access.
   - I attached a one-page trial terms summary (redwood-trial-terms-v1.pdf) to expedite procurement.

Next actions I propose this week:
   1) Can you confirm Marcus as infra owner and Emily as acceptance owner?
   2) If procurement OK, sign the trial terms (we can do an initial emailed acceptance) — target is EOD Monday to keep Week 0 activities on schedule.
   3) Ben and I will run the security kickoff (15–30m) once you share the questionnaire link.

Happy to tighten the plan to whatever cadence you prefer — call out anything you want pulled forward or removed.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
(rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0123)

Attachments: redwood_6week_trial_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), helix_success_criteria_draft.docx (doc), redwood-trial-terms-v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@helix.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@helix.io>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & success gates — proposed 6-week trial plan for Helix IO

Rachel —

Appreciate the clear plan and owners. Quick notes from our side after an internal sync:

- Marcus is confirmed as the infra owner and will coordinate staging creds.
- The acceptance criteria look reasonable but we’d like to add one operational gate: error rate on production-like traffic <= 0.5% (measured over a 24h sample).
- Security: our InfoSec team needs a copy of the SOC2 report and a filled vendor questionnaire before we provide S3 creds. Can you share the SOC2 link and a draft of your answers?
- Procurement: we can sign a one-week proof-of-concept acceptance by next Wednesday (2026-06-24) but would like to shift the start of model tuning to the following Monday (week 1 becomes 2026-06-29) — gives us time for procurement.

If the shifted start works, Marcus will send a calendar invite for a short kickoff on 2026-06-29.

—Emily
Emily Torres
Head of Product, Helix IO
emily.torres@helix.io | (617) 555-8822

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Emily Torres <emily.torres@helix.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & success gates — proposed 6-week trial plan for Helix IO

Thanks, Emily — shifting the start to 2026-06-29 is fine on our side. Rachel and I talked through the operational gate you asked for — we can include the error-rate metric as an explicit success gate.

Operational notes / ownership updates:
- I’ll own runtime tuning (batching, KV cache settings, quant profiles) and produce a mid-week performance snapshot every Friday during the trial.
- Karthik will run the human eval pipeline and deliver the batch of 150 prompts with pass/fail annotations by the end of Week 5.
- Rachel — I’ll need the SOC2 link and your draft questionnaire answers by EOD tomorrow so Marcus can unblock procurement.

Procurement cadence: Rachel, happy to support an emailed acceptance if legal/procurement need a light paper trail.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199

Emily —

All good — we’ll incorporate the 0.5% error-rate gate into the acceptance criteria and shift Week 1 start to 2026-06-29. Ben — thanks, please circulate the SOC2 link and the draft questionnaire answers by EOD. I attached the one-pager terms to the original email to speed procurement; if legal needs any tweaks, we can accept a short email signature as the minimal acceptance to start Week 0 activities.

Proposed immediate actions for everyone:
- Marcus: send a 30m kickoff invite for 2026-06-29 (morning PT preferred).
- Ben: SOC2 link + draft questionnaire answers by EOD 2026-06-21.
- Emily: confirm the team who will review the evaluation prompts for quality (we’ll need 2 reviewers internally).
- Karthik: prep the human-eval template and share the prompt list by 2026-06-25.

If we get the SOC2 and creds in short order we’ll run the initial smoke test within 48 hours of the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.
